battle.name: 岳飛收復襄陽六郡之戰
battle.brief: 紹興四年五月至七月，岳飛率三萬五千人的岳家軍自鄂州渡江，先拔郢州，再取襄陽、隨州，七月北進克鄧州、唐州與信陽軍，收復偽齊與金人據守的六郡，是南宋立國以來首次收復大片失地。漢水浮橋與江上舟師的配合，是希臘火這類縱火兵器在宋金水戰中的對應物；成敗仍由攻城工程與糧秣決定。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰雙方是南宋，與金朝扶植的偽齊漢軍，金朝以少量援軍參與。南宋一方的主力是岳飛直轄的岳家軍，用於進攻襄漢六郡的總兵力約三萬五千人，編制上除岳飛本部各軍外，還併入原李橫部的李道部、原翟琮部的董先部等隊伍，以及荊湖北路安撫使司顏孝恭部約一千九百人、崔邦弼部三千人與荊南鎮撫使司的兵馬。朝廷以淮南西路劉光世部為策援，七月二十六日由其部將酈瓊率五千人抵達襄漢前線；與岳家軍防區相鄰的荊南府還駐著王彥的行營前護副軍，號稱八字軍。指揮系統方面，岳飛的制置使官職添上「兼制置荊南、鄂、岳」以及「兼黃州、復州、漢陽軍、德安府」等加銜，實際上成為荊襄方向唯一的統帥，但中樞調兵仍須經宰相朱勝非與參知政事趙鼎議定，樞密院簽書徐俯則力主反對。偽齊方面以劉豫為主腦，前線大將李成統攝主力，郢州有知州荊超、長壽知縣劉楫，隨州有知州王嵩，唐州知州胡安中、鄧州守將高仲等分守各城。金方以元帥完顏宗弼為最高指揮，他三月在川陝殺金坪大敗於吳玠，主力折損，盛夏北上避暑，無力再如前一年傾巢南下，只能派二等戰將劉合孛堇率陝西、河北偽軍數萬，會合李成在鄧州西北紮營三十餘處，與偽齊漢軍共同守防。
countriesEn: The two sides in this were the Southern Song on one hand, and on the other the Han troops of the puppet state of Qi maintained by the Jin court, with a small Jin force taking part. The main body on the Song side was the Yue family army under Yue Fei's own command, with a total strength of about thirty-five thousand men for the advance on the six prefectures of Xiang and Han. To this were added the troops of Li Dao from the former command of Li Heng, the detachment of Dong Xian from the former command of Zhai Zong, some one thousand nine hundred men of the Hubei pacifying commission under Yan Xiaogong, the three thousand of Cui Bangbi, and the soldiers of the Jingnan military pacification office. The court kept the army of Liu Guangshi on the Huai west as reinforcement, and on the twenty-sixth of the seventh month his commander Li Qiong reached the Xiang-Han front with five thousand men; the corps known as the eight-character corps, the advance guard of the field camp under Wang Yan, was stationed at Jingnan fu alongside the ground held by the Yue army. As for command, the title of pacifying and directing commissioner held by Yue Fei was extended to read that he concurrently directed Jingnan, E and Yue, and to add Huangzhou, Fuzhou, Hanyang jun and De'an fu, which made him in effect the sole commander in the Jing-Xiang direction; yet the movement of troops at the centre still had to be settled by the chancellor Zhu Shengfei and the vice minister Zhao Ding, while the sub-secretary of the privy council Xu Fu argued against the appointment. On the Qi side the directing mind was Liu Yu and the front was held by the general Li Cheng, the prefect of Yingzhou Jing Chao, the magistrate of Changshou Liu Ji, the prefect of Suizhou Wang Song, the prefect of Tangzhou Hu Anzhong and the garrison commander of Dengzhou Gao Zhong each sitting in one city. On the Jin side the supreme command was Wanyan Zongbi: in the third month he had been badly beaten at Shajin in the Sichuan-Shaanxi theatre, his main force was mauled, and in high summer the Jurchen had gone north to escape the heat, so the Jin could not send a great army south as they had the year before. They could only send the second-rank commander Liu He Bojin with several tens of thousands drawn from the puppet armies of Shaanxi and Hebei, to join Li Cheng in thirty-odd camps to the north-west of Dengzhou and hold the line with the Han troops of Qi.
people: 核心人物是岳飛。紹興三年李橫北伐失敗退保江上時，李道、牛皋等曾屢次上書，請求把軍隊交由岳飛節制，宋廷於是把牛皋、董先一千餘人及李道等部併入岳家軍。紹興四年出師之前，岳飛自行定下次第，謂「先襄漢，襄漢既復，李成喪師而逃，楊幺失援矣」；宰相朱勝非贊成取襄之策，說襄陽上流襟帶吳、蜀，進可以蹙賊，退可以保境；參知政事趙鼎力薦，說知上流利害無如飛者；樞密院簽書徐俯反對委派岳飛，淮南西路統制劉光世更要求改由自己措置荊襄，最後朝廷仍命岳飛領兵。岳飛麾下：王貴、張憲、徐慶三人受高宗特賜捻金線戰袍與金束帶；牛皋自請以三日口糧馳援隨州；十六歲的岳雲兩度率先登城；選鋒軍統制李道攻取唐州；張憲與徐慶東北取隨州；統制王萬與荊南府鎮撫使司統制辛太守奉命駐清水河誘敵，辛太守怯戰私自逃往宜都，反倒暴露援軍虛實。敵方以劉豫、李成為主，李成屢敗，號稱三十萬的偽齊大軍實為拼湊之眾，敗後退保新野。金方主將完顏宗弼三月在殺金坪大敗，遠在北方只能坐看襄漢易幟，遣劉合孛堇率數萬往援，兵至已無可施。
peopleEn: The central figure is Yue Fei. When Li Heng's northern expedition of the third year of Shaoxing failed and fell back to the river, Li Dao, Niu Gao and others petitioned again and again to have the troops placed under Yue Fei's command, and the court accordingly folded Niu Gao, Dong Xian and some thousand men together with the troops of Li Dao and his like into the Yue family army. Before setting out in the fourth year of Shaoxing, Yue Fei fixed the order of operations himself: first take Xiang and Han, and once Xiang and Han are recovered, Li Cheng will lose his army and flee and Yang Yao will lose his support. The chancellor Zhu Shengfei supported the plan, saying that Xiangyang on the upper river clasps Wu and Shu by the hand, so that holding it allows one to press the enemy in front and to guard the border behind; the vice minister Zhao Ding recommended him warmly, saying that no one knew the stakes of the upper river better than Fei; the sub-secretary of the privy council Xu Fu argued against entrusting the command to Yue Fei, and the commander on the Huai west Liu Guangshi went further and asked to be given the management of Jing and Xiang himself, but the court in the end still sent Yue Fei out. Under him: Wang Gui, Zhang Xian and Xu Qing received from the emperor special scarlet-threaded battle robes and gold belts; Niu Gao volunteered to race to Suizhou with three days of rations; the sixteen-year-old Yue Yun was the first man up the wall on two occasions; the commander of the vanguard Li Dao took Tangzhou; Zhang Xian and Xu Qing moved north-east onto Suizhou; the commander Wang Wan and the commander of the Jingnan military pacification office Xin Taishou were posted at the Qingshui river to draw the enemy in, and Xin Taishou, who lacked courage for the fight, fled privately to Yidu, thereby exposing the hollow state of the reinforcements. On the enemy side the minds were Liu Yu and Li Cheng; Li Cheng was beaten again and again, the army of three hundred thousand proclaimed by the Qi was in truth a patchwork of pressed men, and after its defeat it fell back on Xinye. On the Jin side the commander in chief Wanyan Zongbi had been badly beaten at Shajin in the third month and could only sit far to the north and watch Xiang and Han change hands, sending Liu He Bojin with several tens of thousands to the relief; but by the time the aid arrived there was nothing left to be done about.
kits: 卡面這件希臘火，是拜占庭帝國自七世紀末起用於海戰的縱火兵器：燃燒劑盛在銅管之中，靠船上的機械推送或人力噴射，配方是帝國最高的機密，配方隨失船一同沉入海底。卡面兵器在這場戰爭裡並沒有以原物參戰，它的位置是標示同一條技術路線在東西方的差距。宋朝在江漢水系能對應的，是舟師與縱火器材的組合：岳飛所部在長江與漢水之間有專門的水上部隊，早年造八德船與海鰍船供士卒在水上操練，攻城與野戰都備有火箭、火油與火筒一類的燃燒投射物，用來燒灼攻城梯、封鎖浮橋與江面船隻。襄陽與樊城之間靠一座浮橋連接江面兩岸，岳家軍正是取道浮橋渡過漢水攻入襄陽，其後拆橋斷絕金人來路；水上的火若落在浮橋與繫舟上，作用與拜占庭海戰中的希臘火相近，都是以一次性燃燒器材改變水面的通行條件。除火器之外，這場戰役的硬裝備以弩、砲、雲梯、撞竿與攻城塔為主，郢州、隨州、鄧州三役都是強攻破城；金人與偽齊的戰術骨幹則是重鎧拐子馬騎兵，李成一度把騎兵列在江岸、步卒列在平地，被岳飛以長槍步兵與騎兵交叉衝擊破解。糧秣與運輸同樣吃重：出師時軍糧僅夠兩餐，後勤靠漢水與沔水轉運，收復襄陽之後就地屯儲、置辦軍器，作為北進唐、鄧的基地。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on the card was the incendiary weapon the Byzantine empire put to work in naval battle from the end of the seventh century: the burning mixture was carried in copper tubes, driven out by machinery in the ship or by human power, the formula was the highest secret of the empire, and the formula went down with the ship that was lost. The weapon on the card did not take part in this war in its own form; its place is to mark out the distance between the two ends of one technological line. What the Song could match on the river country of Jiang and Han was the combination of a boat force with incendiary material: Yue Fei's men had a waterborne arm of their own between the Yangtze and the Han, had built the eight-virtue boat and the saw-toothed boat in earlier years for the troops to drill on the water, and carried fire arrows, fire oil and fire tubes in both siege and field work, to burn siege ladders, to seal the floating bridge and to set light to boats on the river. Between Xiangyang and Fancheng the two banks of the river were joined by a floating bridge, and it was by that bridge that the Yue army crossed the Han and entered Xiangyang, and afterwards the bridge was broken up to cut the Jin's approach. A fire let loose on the water, on a bridge or on moored hulls, served the same end as the Greek fire in the Byzantine sea battles: a one-shot incendiary used to alter the conditions of passage on the water. Apart from incendiaries, the hard equipment of this war was crossbow, stone thrower, ladder, battering ram and siege tower, and the assaults on Yingzhou, Suizhou and Dengzhou were all storming actions. The tactical backbone of the Jin and the Qi was the armoured war-horse, and Li Cheng at one point drew his cavalry along the bank and his infantry on the plain, only to be broken by Yue Fei, who sent pike-armed foot against the horse and horse against the foot in a cross. Logistics were no lighter: the army marched out with barely two meals of grain, the supply line ran up the Han and the Mian, and once Xiangyang was taken the grain was stored on the spot and the ordnance was laid in there, forming the base for the drive on Tang and Deng.
tactics: 岳飛的戰略次序很清楚：先取襄漢，再圖洞庭。他給朝廷的方案是「先襄漢，襄漢既復，李成喪師而逃，楊幺失援矣」，目標不是單純攻城，而是斬斷偽齊李成、許約與洞庭湖楊幺、黃誠南北夾攻、順江東下的默契。具體打法是速戰與分進合擊並行。五月五日岳家軍抵郢州城下，偽齊知州荊超與長壽知縣劉楫率一萬餘人拒降，岳飛以翌日巳時破賊為期，六日黎明即行總攻，城破、荊超投崖自盡，斬首七千餘級，拔郢州正是打開漢水通道。然後分兵：張憲、徐慶東北取隨州，岳飛率主力西北攻襄陽，李成不戰而走，五月十七日宋軍入城；五月十八日牛皋自薦馳援，三日口糧未盡，隨州城破，岳雲持鐵錐槍率先登城，偽齊兵五千人全滅。誘敵一段由王萬與辛太守在清水河承擔，辛太守私自逃往宜都，反倒讓李成輕敵深入。六月五日岳飛主力與王萬部夾擊破李成，六日李成再列陣，岳飛看出他左列騎兵於江岸、右列步卒於平地的破綻，命王貴以長槍步兵擊其騎兵、牛皋以騎兵擊其步卒，李成前列騎兵一潰即把後列擠入江中淹死，全軍崩潰。北進唐、鄧一段採南北兩路並進：七月十五日王貴、張憲由光化路與橫林路夾擊鄧州城北三十餘里的金偽軍，王萬、董先突然出現，金將劉合孛堇單騎逃竄；十七日攻鄧州，岳雲再先登城；二十三日李道取唐州，同日信陽軍下，俘偽齊官員五十名。縱火與舟師的配合則貫穿全程：江上封鎖、浮橋斷拆、焚燒攻城梯，都是水火並用的例子。
tacticsEn: The order of operations Yue Fei set himself was plain: take Xiang and Han first, then turn to Dongting. The plan he put to the court was that once Xiang and Han were recovered, Li Cheng would lose his army and flee and Yang Yao would lose his support, and the object was not simply to take cities but to cut the understanding between Li Cheng and Xu Yu of the Qi on one side and Yang Yao and Huang Cheng of Dongting lake on the other, who had arranged to close on the Song from north and south and come down the river to the east. The method in practice was speed combined with converging attacks from separate lines. On the fifth day of the fifth month the Yue army came up under the walls of Yingzhou, where the Qi prefect Jing Chao and the magistrate of Changshou Liu Ji held more than ten thousand men and refused to surrender; Yue Fei gave them until the hour of the serpent the next day, and at the first light of the sixth the general assault went in, the city fell, Jing Chao threw himself from the cliff, and seven thousand of the defenders were cut down; taking Yingzhou was precisely the opening of the passage on the Han. The force then split: Zhang Xian and Xu Qing went north-east onto Suizhou while Yue Fei took the main body north-west against Xiangyang, where Li Cheng fled without fighting, and the Song entered the city on the seventeenth; on the eighteenth Niu Gao volunteered to ride to the relief, and in three days the city of Suizhou fell before the rations were exhausted, Yue Yun with his iron-piked spear being the first on the wall, and five thousand of the Qi troops were destroyed. The part played by the bait was taken by Wang Wan and Xin Taishou at the Qingshui river; Xin Taishou's private flight to Yidu helped rather than hurt, for it persuaded Li Cheng that the enemy was weaker than he was. On the fifth day of the sixth month Yue Fei's main body closed with Wang Wan's men and beat Li Cheng, and on the sixth Li Cheng drew up his lines again, whereupon Yue Fei read the flaw in him, that the cavalry stood on the river bank on his left and the infantry on the plain on his right, and gave Wang Gui the pike-armed foot to strike the horse and Niu Gao the horse to strike the foot; the front rank of Li Cheng's cavalry broke and bore down his second rank into the water, and his army came apart. The advance on Tang and Deng was made on two lines running north and south: on the fifteenth day of the seventh month Wang Gui and Zhang Xian came out by the Guanghua and Henglin roads and fell on the Jin and Qi force a little over thirty li north of Dengzhou, Wang Wan and Dong Xian suddenly appearing on the flank, and the Jin general Liu He Bojin fled alone; on the seventeenth they stormed Dengzhou, Yue Yun again first up the wall; on the twenty-third Li Dao took Tangzhou, and on the same day Xinyang jun fell and fifty Qi officials were captured. The combination of fire and boat force ran through the whole operation: sealing the river, breaking the floating bridge and burning the siege ladders are all instances of water and fire used together.
data: 可核對的數字不少。時間線最清楚：紹興三年十月金軍攻佔伊陽風牛山寨、鄧州、隨州、唐州、襄陽府與郢州；紹興四年五月五日岳家軍抵郢州城下，五月六日破郢州，五月十七日入襄陽，五月十八日下隨州，六月五日與六日連敗李成，七月十五日鄧州城外交戰，七月十七日克鄧州，七月二十三日取唐州與信陽軍，七月二十六日淮南西路援軍五千人抵達已無仗可打，全役自五月至七月約三個月。兵力方面，岳家軍用於進攻襄漢六郡的總兵力約三萬五千人，其中新併入的顏孝恭部約一千九百人、崔邦弼部三千人；偽齊在郢州守軍一萬餘人，號稱三十萬大軍者為虛張之數，實際由李成殘部與新集之眾拼湊；金朝援軍為陝西、河北偽軍數萬，在鄧州西北紮營三十餘處。斬獲可數：破郢州斬首達七千；隨州殲偽齊軍五千；鄧州之戰俘降簽軍將領楊德勝等二百餘人，奪戰馬二百多匹；信陽軍一役俘偽齊唐州知州、信陽軍知軍、通判等官員共五十名；生擒劉楫、王嵩、高仲，王嵩被押赴襄陽處斬。糧秣與補充亦可見記錄：出師時軍糧不過兩餐，牛皋出戰僅帶三日口糧；朝廷自張俊的神武右軍、楊沂中的神威中軍各撥戰馬一百匹給岳家軍，並賜王貴、張憲、徐慶捻金線戰袍各一領、金束帶各一條。
dataEn: There is a good deal that can be checked. The chronology is the clearest part: in the tenth month of the third year of Shaoxing the Jin took the Fengniu stockade at Yiyang, Dengzhou, Suizhou, Tangzhou, Xiangyang fu and Yingzhou; in the fourth year of Shaoxing the Yue army came up under Yingzhou on the fifth day of the fifth month, carried the city on the sixth, entered Xiangyang on the seventeenth, took Suizhou on the eighteenth, beat Li Cheng on the fifth and sixth days of the sixth month, fought the battle north of Dengzhou on the fifteenth of the seventh, carried Dengzhou on the seventeenth, took Tangzhou and Xinyang jun on the twenty-third, and on the twenty-sixth the five thousand reinforcements from the Huai west arrived to find that there was no longer any fighting to be done; the whole operation from the fifth to the seventh month lasted about three months. As to strength, the total used by the Yue army for the advance on the six prefectures was about thirty-five thousand men, including among the newly attached troops some one thousand nine hundred of Yan Xiaogong and three thousand of Cui Bangbi; the Qi garrison at Yingzhou numbered over ten thousand, while the thirty thousand proclaimed by the Qi was a boast, the real force being a patchwork of Li Cheng's remnants and freshly pressed men; the Jin reinforcements were several tens of thousands drawn from the puppet armies of Shaanxi and Hebei, encamped in thirty-odd places to the north-west of Dengzhou. The tally of captures can be set out: seven thousand cut down at Yingzhou; five thousand of the Qi troops destroyed at Suizhou; at Dengzhou two hundred and odd officers of the surrendered and assigned troops, Yang Desheng and his like, were taken prisoner and more than two hundred horses were seized; at Xinyang jun fifty officials of the Qi, including the prefect of Tangzhou, the military governor of Xinyang jun and the registrar, were captured; Liu Ji, Wang Song and Gao Zhong were taken alive, and Wang Song was put to death at Xiangyang. Supply is recorded too: the army marched out with no more than two meals of grain, and when Niu Gao went out to fight he took three days of rations only; the court assigned a hundred war-horses each from Zhang Jun's Divine Might Right Army and Yang Yizhong's Divine Might Central Army to the Yue army, and presented Wang Gui, Zhang Xian and Xu Qing with a scarlet-threaded battle robe apiece and a gold belt apiece.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最表層是領土與屏障的喪失：紹興三年李橫、翟琮一度北伐偽齊，收復汝州、潁昌府、信陽軍等地，三月卻在牟施岡被金人重鎧拐子馬擊潰，隨後到十月，伊陽風牛山寨、鄧州、隨州、唐州、襄陽府、郢州相繼被金軍攻佔，荊襄上游的門戶盡失，長江防線直接暴露在敵騎之下。第二層是敵方的南北夾攻陰謀：偽齊李成、許約與洞庭湖楊幺、黃誠相約翌年六月水陸並進、順江東下直取浙中，一旦兩股力量在長江中游會合，南宋腹心就會被貫穿，岳飛「先襄漢」的方案正是要在那個日子之前先斷其一臂。第三層是朝廷的戰略選擇：朱勝非、趙鼎等主戰派看準襄漢上游進可蹙賊、退可保境的位置，力主先取襄陽，徐俯反對、劉光世爭功，因此拖延了一段。同時還有一個客觀窗口：金元帥完顏宗弼三月在川陝殺金坪大敗金軍主力，盛夏女真人北上避暑，金廷無力大舉南下，只能派小股援軍應付，這正是岳家軍得以在五月出手的原因。
causeEn: There are three layers of reason behind the fighting. The outermost is the loss of territory and of the screen that protected the interior: in the third year of Shaoxing Li Heng and Zhai Zong made a northern expedition against the Qi and recovered Ruzhou, Yingchang fu and Xinyang jun, but in the third month they were routed at Moushi Gang by the Jin armoured war-horse, and by the tenth month Fengniu stockade at Yiyang, Dengzhou, Suizhou, Tangzhou, Xiangyang fu and Yingzhou had fallen one after another to the Jin, the gateway of the Jing-Xiang upper river was lost entirely, and the defences of the Yangtze were laid bare to the enemy's horse. The second layer is the plot to close on the Song from north and south: Li Cheng and Xu Yu of the Qi and Yang Yao and Huang Cheng of Dongting lake had arranged to move by water and by land together in the sixth month of the following year, to come down the river to the east and strike at the Zhezhong region; if the two forces had joined on the middle Yangtze the heart of the Southern Song would have been pierced, and the plan of taking Xiang and Han first was precisely to break one of the two arms before that date arrived. The third layer is the strategic choice made at court: the war party, with Zhu Shengfei and Zhao Ding, fixed on the position of the upper Xiang-Han, from which one could press the enemy in front and guard the realm behind, and urged that Xiangyang be taken first; Xu Fu objected and Liu Guangshi competed for the honour, so the matter was delayed for a while. There was also an objective opening: the Jin commander in chief Wanyan Zongbi had destroyed his own main force at Shajin in the Sichuan-Shaanxi theatre in the third month, and in high summer the Jurchen withdrew north to escape the heat, so the Jin court had no strength to send a great army south and could only send a small force to answer, and that is why the Yue army was able to strike in the fifth month.
impact: 這是南宋立國八年以來第一次收復大片失地，意義不在城池數目而在體面。收復襄陽之後，岳飛以襄陽為軍師府所在，屯兵整軍、修城造器、儲糧置酒，經營荊襄約兩年，兵源與糧秣都從此地補充，其後紹興六年再取商、虢，紹興十年郾城、潁昌、朱仙鎮一役的北伐，都以這塊基地為支點。偽齊李成重傷，與楊幺合兵的計劃破滅，岳家軍得以回師洞庭，翌年平定楊幺時已無北方牽制。聲望的另一面是猜忌：收復六郡之後，岳飛的軍權與兵望同步膨脹，主和派與樞密院對他的疑慮隨之上升，這條線最終通向紹興十年的十二道金牌。從技術史看，這場戰役留下兩組對照：水面上的火——希臘火那一類以秘密配方改變水況的縱火兵器，與宋軍的舟師、浮橋、火油火箭，是同一條線索的東西兩個版本；城下的火——火箭燒梯、穴地逼近、砲擊城頭——與糧道，才是真正決定勝負的一環。襄陽此後數百年一直是南宋的北方門戶，直至宋末襄樊之役失守，荊襄的屏障才真正崩潰。
impactEn: This was the first recovery of a wide stretch of lost ground since the founding of the Southern Song eight years earlier, and its meaning lay less in the number of cities than in the sense of standing. After Xiangyang was taken Yue Fei made it the seat of his headquarters, quartered and drilled troops there, repaired the walls, made the ordnance, stored the grain and set up the workshops, and worked the Jing-Xiang region for roughly two years; the men and the grain of the later expeditions came from that base, and the campaign against Shang and Guo in the sixth year of Shaoxing and the fighting at Yancheng, Yingchang and Zhuxianzhen in the tenth year all rested on it. Li Cheng was badly hurt, the plan of joining forces with Yang Yao came to nothing, and the Yue army was able to turn back on Dongting, so that when Yang Yao was put down the following year there was no northern partner to draw him off. The other side of the renown was suspicion: after the six prefectures were recovered, the military authority of Yue Fei and his standing with the troops grew together, and the doubts of the peace party and of the privy council rose with them, and that thread runs on to the twelve gold tablets of the tenth year of Shaoxing. In the history of technique the war leaves two sets of contrasts. The fire on the water — the Greek fire, that incendiary which changed the condition of the water by a secret formula, set against the Song fleet, the floating bridge, the fire oil and the fire arrows — is one and the same thread in an eastern and a western version. The fire under the wall — the fire arrows burning the ladders, the digging in under the foundations, the stone thrown at the heads of the wall — together with the supply line, is the part that really decided the outcome. Xiangyang remained the northern gateway of the Southern Song for several centuries afterwards, and it was not until the war for Xiang and Fan in the last years of the Song that the screen of Jing and Xiang truly collapsed.
result: 六郡盡復。郢州、襄陽、隨州、鄧州、唐州、信陽軍相繼易幟，偽齊在荊襄與中原西路的據點被連根拔去，李成一軍元氣大傷，此後再無力反攻襄陽；偽齊知州劉楫、鄧州守將高仲被擒，隨州知州王嵩被押赴襄陽處斬，偽齊官員五十人被俘虜送京。金將劉合孛堇在鄧州城外交戰中只身逃竄，所部三十餘營寨隨之瓦解。淮南西路援軍五千人直到七月二十六日才到，岳飛仍上奏請朝廷先行推賞，以免將士無功而心冷。對岳家軍本身，這是一場以極短時間完成的戰役：五月五日抵郢州，五月十八日前後下隨州，只用了半個多月，最遠處攻到唐、鄧也不過百餘日。對南宋全局，它終止了金偽齊在荊襄方向的進攻，把失守近一年的襄漢重新變成進取的支點，卻沒有觸及改變宋金力量對比的核心問題；戰後朝廷加封岳飛鄂國公，隨即把注意力轉向和議，這一場勝仗既是岳飛聲望的頂點，也成了他和南宋朝廷之間裂痕的起點。
resultEn: The six prefectures were all recovered. Yingzhou, Xiangyang, Suizhou, Dengzhou, Tangzhou and Xinyang jun changed hands one after another, the Qi footholds in Jing-Xiang and on the western road of the Central Plains were torn out root and branch, and Li Cheng's army never recovered its strength nor was able to attack Xiangyang again; the Qi prefect Liu Ji and the garrison commander of Dengzhou Gao Zhong were taken alive, the prefect of Suizhou Wang Song was put to death at Xiangyang, and fifty Qi officials were sent to the capital as prisoners. The Jin general Liu He Bojin fled alone in the action north of Dengzhou, and the thirty-odd camps of his command came apart with him. The five thousand reinforcements from the Huai west did not arrive until the twenty-sixth of the seventh month, and Yue Fei still petitioned the court to reward them in the first instance, so that the soldiers should not be left cold with no share of the merit. For the Yue army itself this was a campaign completed in an exceptionally short time: from the fifth day of the fifth month at Yingzhou to the fall of Suizhou about the eighteenth, the space of half a month, and the farthest point reached, at Tang and Deng, took no more than a hundred days. For the Song as a whole it ended the advance of the Jin and the Qi in the Jing-Xiang direction and turned the Xiang-Han region, lost for nearly a year, back into a base for offensive operations, but it did not touch the central question of the balance of strength between Song and Jin. After it the court enfeoffed Yue Fei as Duke of E, and the attention of the court soon turned towards a negotiated peace; this victory was both the high point of Yue Fei's renown and the beginning of the fissure between him and the government of the Southern Song.
